proposal_title: Event Envelope Standardization with OpenTelemetry Distributed Tracing & Topic Naming
domain_specific_rationale: From a Contracts and Event-Driven Architecture perspective, CP-005 establishes a single, strongly-typed event envelope specification across all asynchronous message brokers. In event-envelope.schema.json, the event contract mandates essential distributed context fields: event_id (UUID), event_type (enforced via regex ^avf\.[a-z0-9_-]+(\.[a-z0-9_-]+)+$), aggregate_id, aggregate_version, timestamp_utc (date-time), correlation_id (UUID), trace_id (OpenTelemetry W3C trace regex), span_id (16 hex chars regex), schema_version (SemVer regex), and payload (object). This strict standardization guarantees end-to-end distributed tracing across microservices and eliminates brittle event routing caused by inconsistent casing or schema divergence.
capability_impact: Preserves CAP-04 (Event-Driven Integration) and CAP-14 (Platform Observability & Distributed Tracing).
residual_risk: High-throughput events could incur serialization overhead with large metadata envelopes. Mitigated by lightweight JSON schema design and strict OTel header formatting.
